Description
UWE Bristol has received numerous awards for its teaching excellence including Top 10 in the UK for student experience by Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide 2020, Gold Award for teaching by the Teaching Excellence Framework, and is Top 30 in the UK overall according to the Guardian University Guide 2020Based on UWE Bristol's Frenchay campus, the International College is where students will study their pathway course. Students have access to the University's facilities, and after passing the course at the required level, students have guaranteed entry to the degree program of their choice.
